chatResults.question: Is my donation 80G eligible?
chatResults.reply: Tax treatment of contributions is subject to applicable law and confirmation of the Trust's current statutory eligibility. MECT holds a historical Section 80G order (URN: AADTM5474FF20241) covering AY 2024-25 to AY 2026-27. This order does not by itself confirm eligibility for donations made now.

chatResults.question: Will I get a tax receipt?
chatResults.reply: You will receive an Official Donation Receipt & Payment Acknowledgement after the Trust checks your State Bank of India transfer or UPI payment against its bank records. Formal tax certificates are subject to applicable statutory filing.

chatResults.question: How much tax will I save?
chatResults.reply: MECT does not calculate or guarantee personal tax savings. Tax treatment of contributions is subject to applicable law and confirmation of the Trust's current statutory eligibility. Please consult your tax advisor regarding your specific tax filing.

chatResults.question: Is the trust registered?
chatResults.reply: Yes. Mahaveer Educational & Charitable Trust (MECT) is an irrevocable public charitable trust registered under the Indian Trusts Act, 1882 at Balangir, Odisha (Trust Deed No. 40311302194, registered 30-07-2013). The Trust holds PAN AADTM5474F, MCA CSR-1 registration CSR00081063, and NITI Aayog NGO Darpan ID OR/2024/0466491.

chatResults.question: Can I pay by card?
chatResults.reply: No. MECT does not accept credit or debit cards, and does not operate an online payment gateway. Contributions are accepted exclusively via direct State Bank of India bank transfer (NEFT/RTGS) or official UPI (86971610172@sbi). Details are available at https://mect.org.in/donate.
